title: Recipe-driven voice — voice colour derives from appearance (proportions + palette + accessories), not just raw seed
intent: Today `voiceParamsFromSeed(seed)` (S110) hashes the raw recipe seed into 10 voice knobs. Result: a bomber's voice is decoupled from how it LOOKS. Switching palette from ember → mint, or shrinking the torso, or adding antennae — none of these change the voice. The user feedback 2026-05-28: 'голос персонажа должен зависеть от его внешнего вида, изменяется внешний вид - изменяется голос'. This story replaces seed-only derivation with `voiceParamsFromRecipe(recipe)`: voice axes map to visible appearance features. Big torso → low voice. Big head → higher F1. Warm palette → harsher Q. Antennae → noisy timbre. Visor → muffled. Fins → fluttery vibrato. The seed becomes a SMALL residual jitter on top — preserves individual identity between recipes that look similar — but the BULK of the voice is appearance-driven. Player intuition lands: 'tall bomber sounds deep, cap-wearing bomber sounds friendly, robot-with-antennae sounds metallic'.
rationale: Source: user feedback 2026-05-28. Strong design fit with `docs/game-design/voice-synth-design.md §5.3` (10-knob voice colour) — that doc treats appearance + voice as TWO INDEPENDENT identity layers. User's intuition is that they're ONE identity (appearance suggests sound). Pairs with `GDP-2026-05-28-005` voice tuning — together they fix two sides of the 'voice feels disconnected' issue: 005 fixes timing/timbre to actually sound like speech; 006 fixes derivation so the speech matches the body. Both small, both shipped in same sprint = compounded improvement.
acceptanceHints: DEPENDS ON: GDP-2026-05-28-005 (voice tuning) is parallel — not blocking. Either order works; together they ship the voice-feels-right combo. If 005 ships first, this story slots cleanly on top. If 006 ships first, 005's tuning still applies.
examples/kaboom-crew/src/voice-synth.ts: NEW function `voiceParamsFromRecipe(recipe: CharacterRecipe): VoiceColour`.
Existing `voiceParamsFromSeed(seed: string)` stays available — used by tests + legacy paths. Default bootstrap call switches to `voiceParamsFromRecipe`.
DERIVATION FORMULAE (each maps recipe field → voice axis within the existing 0..1 normalized range, then `lerp` into the knob's hard range from voice-synth.ts):
basePitchHz (range 90..260):
base_t = inverseLerp(0.35, 0.60, recipe.proportions.torsoHeight) // big torso → high t
voice_t = 1 - base_t // inverse: big torso → LOW voice
backpack adjustment: if 'backpack' in recipe.accessories, voice_t -= 0.15 (bassier)
seed jitter: voice_t += (seedRand() - 0.5) × 0.10 // ±5% individuality
formantF1Hz (range 300..900):
head_t = inverseLerp(0.25, 0.45, recipe.proportions.headSize) // big head → high t
seed jitter: ±5%
formantF2Hz (range 1200..2400):
visor_t = 'visor' in recipe.accessories ? 0.2 : 0.7 // visor → muffled, lower F2; no visor → bright
seed jitter: ±5%
formantQ (range 4..12):
Warm palette families (ember/sand/rose): t = 0.7..1.0
Cool palette families (sky/mint/jade/slate/plum): t = 0.0..0.4
seed jitter: ±5%
vibratoHz (range 0..8):
'fins' in recipe.accessories ? t = 0.7 (fluttery) : t = 0.3
seed jitter: ±10%
vibratoDepth (range 0..0.04):
'fins' in recipe.accessories ? t = 0.6 : t = 0.3
seed jitter: ±10%
noiseMix (range 0..0.4):
'antennae' in recipe.accessories ? t = 0.6 : t = 0.2 // antennae → robotic noise
seed jitter: ±10%
phrasePaceMultiplier (range 0.6..1.4):
Bot personality (from S139): hunter t=0.4 (fast), miner t=0.7 (deliberate), coward t=0.5; non-bot t=0.5
seed jitter: ±15%
consonantStyle (range 0..1):
'cap' in recipe.accessories ? t = 0.3 (softer) : t = 0.6 (sharper)
seed jitter: ±10%
vowelDriftAmount (range 0.2..0.6 per GDP-005 tuning):
Pure seed jitter (no appearance correlate) — this is per-individual expressiveness
PALETTE FAMILY → WARM/COOL CLASSIFICATION (for formantQ derivation):
Warm: ember (warm red), sand (yellow-brown), rose (pink) — t = 0.7..1.0 mapped from secondary seed jitter
Cool: sky (blue), mint (green), jade (teal-green), slate (grey-blue), plum (purple) — t = 0.0..0.4
BOT-vs-PLAYER BIAS (preserve from S110):

Bot entities (presence of BotBrain component) still shift toward harsher waveforms (saw/triangle) + higher pitch (300-480Hz instead of 180-380Hz). After the appearance-derivation completes, apply a SECONDARY bot-bias adjustment as today.
BOOTSTRAP INTEGRATION:

examples/kaboom-crew/bootstrap.ts: on bomber spawn (player.1 OR bot.1 OR remote-bomber-decorator), resolve CharacterRecipe + call voiceParamsFromRecipe(recipe). Cache the result on the bomber entity (component or audio-fx-local map).

When recipe changes mid-run (e.g. via bench, via cosmetic unlock applying a new accessory, via `__agf.kaboom.spawnWithRecipe(...)`) → recompute voice + replace the cached VoiceColour. Next play() call uses the new voice.
BENCH INTEGRATION (examples/procbomber-bench):
Each bench slider (proportions, palette, accessories) triggers recipe rebuild AND voice recompute.

NEW: bench panel gains a 'Play voice slot' dropdown — play-bomb / hit / pickup / death / victory + a Play button. Click → invokes the synth with the current recipe's voice colour. User can A/B accessories + immediately hear the difference.
This is the testing harness that validates the appearance-voice mapping by ear in the bench, not in gameplay.
DETERMINISM:
Same recipe → same voice. Bench can save + load recipes deterministically.
Seed jitter component is deterministic from `voice.${recipe.seed}` hash — same seed produces same jitter offsets.
Bot-vs-bot regression test continues to pass (gameplay state unchanged; visual+audio differs but test asserts gameplay).
UNIT TESTS:
voiceParamsFromRecipe(recipe) returns identical VoiceColour on two calls with the same recipe.
Big torso (height 0.60) produces lower basePitchHz than small torso (height 0.35) given otherwise identical recipes.
Visor accessory in recipe produces lower formantF2Hz than no-visor recipe.
Antennae accessory increases noiseMix above the no-antennae baseline.
Warm palette family (ember) produces higher formantQ than cool palette (mint).
Bot recipe (with BotBrain) shifts waveform pool toward harsher (saw/triangle weighted 60/30/10) — verify the bias still applies.
Seed jitter envelope: ±5% on small-jitter knobs, ±10-15% on larger-jitter knobs. Two recipes identical EXCEPT seed produce voices that are CLOSE but distinct.
PLAYTEST QA BAR:
Player listens to a small bomber with ember palette + antennae + cap → reports voice as 'small + warm + robotic + friendly'.
Player listens to a large bomber with slate palette + backpack → reports voice as 'big + cool + bassy'.
Player swaps just the palette ember → mint on the same bomber → voice changes audibly (timbre shifts from warm to cool).
Player adds a visor to the recipe → voice gets noticeably muffled.
Same bomber with same recipe across reloads → identical voice (deterministic).
DOCS UPDATES IN THIS PR:
voice-synth-design.md §5.3 — add a new subsection 'Appearance-driven voice derivation' documenting the mapping table. Mark the seed-only derivation as legacy.
characters-and-visual.md §6.4 — note that voice now derives from full recipe, not just seed.
OUT OF SCOPE:
Animated voice change (voice morphing smoothly during a recipe change). Each new recipe = a snapped voice change (cache replace).
Per-accessory custom phrase patches (e.g. visor bomber has different syllable count). Phrase patches stay slot-driven, NOT accessory-driven.
Custom mapping per user (user assigns 'visor → high pitch' instead of 'low'). Mappings are baked into the derivation formula — not authorable.
Voice-axis mapping for new accessories (drone/puffball archetypes — future).
Audio-watermark of identity (e.g. each bomber has a unique 'theme melody'). Out of scope for tuning.
